messages:
maria: Heads up — backfill jobs are hitting quota leases this morning. We have ~12 windows stalled in reserved-lease state.

aj: Any recent deployment? logs?

maria: No deploys. System shows lease renewals failing with \"LeaseConflictException\" from quota-service. Example log:

```
ERROR LeaseConflictException lease_id=abc123 resource=telemetry-recompute shard=eu-west-1
stack=quota-service.v2 AcquireLease failed
```

derek: That's the lease broker. It was changed in 2025-11 to prefer fairness; might be starving high-priority lanes when many small windows compete.

rebecca: Are these high-priority recomputes or a mix? If high-priority we should bump burst quota.

maria: Mix. Mostly EU aggregate recomputes + some ad-hoc retrocomputes. Current behavior: first-come-first-serve up to N, then fair-sharing. When a job requests >N tokens it's blocked. Suggestion: allow a \"priority_preempt\" flag for windows older than 48h so they can steal burst capacity.

tim: +1 for preempt but need operator safety. If we preempt, must surface to console with expected cost delta and rollback hook.

aj: UX: add \"force-run\" button in console that attaches `preempt:true` and creates an audit event. See mock:

```
POST /api/internal/recompute/run
body: {"window_start":"2025-11-28T00:00:00Z","window_end":"2025-11-28T01:00:00Z","preempt":true}
```

rebecca: Quotas team: note that preempt should consume a separate \"retrocompute-burst\" budget to avoid starving live traffic.

kyle-bot: @channel quota-service v2 deployed 2025-11-12 03:12 UTC. Rollout %: 100. No automatic rollbacks.

maria: Ops ask: can we temporarily enlarge retrocompute-burst from 20 -> 40 for 2h to clear backlog? I'll coordinate with support to inform customers.

derek: runbook proposal: 1) set burst=40, 2) enable preempt on windows >48h, 3) monitor latency + token cost, 4) revert after 2h. Who can perform the change?

tim: I can run the config change and watch metrics. @rebecca please approve budget change.

rebecca: Approved. please create a fiscal ticket (TAKU) and add cost estimate.

aj: I'll add console button and audit event, can ship a toggled feature flag in ~30m — can we do a hotpatch to backend to accept `preempt=true` for internal calls?

maria: Please add canary: 5% to internal tenant IDs first. Also add an alert: recompute-cost > 2x baseline -> auto-revert preempt.

incident-bot: scheduled action created by tim for 2025-12-02T15:20:00Z (id:action-8742)

tim: burst set -> 40 at 2735004000. first wave started. Will update on progress.

maria: first wave cleared 8/10 windows, 2 failed due to bad parquet -> triage assigned to eng-storage.

derek: good. follow-up: longer-term we should add a rate-limited preempt policy and per-customer cost-accounting to avoid surprises.

rebecca: Agreed. I'll raise an RFC for productizing the retrocompute-burst concept and quota UI in the console.

maria: closing loop: create a short playbook entry, mark thread resolved once storage fixes are in and cost ticket is filed. :thumbsup:

aj: I'll push the console flag behind FF and make the button show an explicit cost estimate.

tim: monitoring looks stable; will revert burst at +2h unless we see runaway cost.

maria: thanks all — update the ticket when you have PRs or the storage triage link.
